biography:
“Strategy without execution is just an idea.”
Inspirational leader with top-performance track-record, 19 years of experience in delivery of strategic global projects across 35 countries on all continents. Motivating coach with passion for functional team excellence, creativity and respect for diversity. 
As an accomplished business transformation leader, I delivered over 100 high-profile transformational projects in a global enterprise environment. From state-of-the-art DC and Cloud technologies to mega-factories. I possess a rare multi-functional expertise across IT, Real Estate, HR, Legal and Procurement fields. 
Having worked in Big Tech, Media Anti-piracy/ Technology, Chemical, Academic and entrepreneurial environments, I thrive on creating value for business and society. 
I have a true passion for empowering others to develop and achieve more. I am a spirited diversity advocate with strong appreciation of global cultures and heritage. As the OneMBA Global Executive cohortian, I take pride in fostering cross-cultural dialogue to build sustainable and ethical global businesses.
